_README: BSE scrip codes for symbols absent from scripts/bse_scrips.json, which only carries the ~4,876 CURRENTLY listed scrips. Delisted / merged / share-class names still have BSE announcement history, so a backfill can reach their result filings once it knows the code. A wrong code here is harmless: every consumer PAT-anchors the extracted column against docs/sf_fundamentals.json and writes nothing when it fails to match.
